summary: Ingest journal + evidence into the BD graph as knowledge nodes linked to the code they reference (the 'why' layer). Preview-first.

db.description: graph DB (default: the toolkit's bd_graph store)

journal_db.description: override journal DB path (default: state root)

evidence_db.description: override evidence DB path (default: state root)

link_cap.description: max code links per knowledge node

apply.description: execute for real (equivalent to dry_run:false + confirm:true)
